Our heritage

### Military-standard tailoring, passed from mother to daughter

For more than 50 years Sylvia worked as a tailor for the military at **RAF St Mawgan**, just up the road from Newquay. Uniforms leave no room for "near enough": every hem level, every seam straight, every button where it should be. That is the standard she brings to your jeans, your coats and your curtains.

Over her career Sylvia has also made ball gowns, suits and wedding dresses, so she knows exactly how garments are put together. Today she works with her daughter **Maxine Jennings**, who has spent over three years at her side learning those skills, so the craft carries on in Newquay.

- **50+**years Sylvia has tailored
- **RAF**St Mawgan tailor
- **3+**years Maxine at her side

You asked

### Alterations questions

How much do alterations cost in Newquay?

Our [guide prices](https://newquayseamstress.com/prices/) start from £3 for a button and £10 for a standard jeans hem. Trouser hems are a guide £12, zip replacements from £15 and curtain shortening from £20 per pair. These are guide prices only: the final price is confirmed at drop-off or consultation, depending on the garment and the work needed.

How long do alterations take?

Standard turnaround is 3–5 days. If you need it sooner, our express service turns most jobs around in 24–48 hours for an extra £5.

Do my clothes or curtains need to be washed first?

Yes please. We can only work on clean items, so garments and curtains must be freshly washed before drop-off. It keeps the workroom (and everyone else's clothes) clean and means hems are measured on fabric that has already shrunk.

Can you pin my hem when I drop off?

Yes. We are happy to pin hems at drop-off, so bring the shoes you will wear with trousers or a dress. Alternatively you can pin or measure your preferred length at home and we will work to that.

## Trouser & Jeans Alterations in Newquay

> Jeans and trouser hems in Newquay, guide prices from £10. Original-hem jeans, blind-stitch, turn-ups, waists taken in & legs tapered by a 50-year tailor.

Source: https://newquayseamstress.com/trouser-jeans-alterations-newquay/

Hems · tapering · waists

Jeans hems (including keeping the original factory hem), plain and blind-stitched trouser hems, turn-ups, waists taken in and legs tapered. Guide prices from £10.

[Call 07807 274898](tel:+447807274898)[Guide prices](https://newquayseamstress.com/prices/)

### Trouser hems, jeans hems and fitting in Newquay

Trousers and jeans are the bread and butter of any sewing room, and they are where a tailor's training shows. A hem that sits a few millimetres off, a blind stitch that puckers, or a jeans hem that loses its faded edge are all things you notice every time you get dressed. Sylvia learned to hem uniform trousers to military standard at RAF St Mawgan, and that is how every pair is finished here.

![Denim jeans with a chalked hem line beside a brass zip, vintage buttons, tape measure and tailor's chalk](https://newquayseamstress.com/assets/img/jeans-hemming-zip-repair-newquay-1024.webp)

### What we do

- **Standard jeans hem**: shortened and re-stitched with matching heavy thread.
- **Jeans hem keeping the original factory hem**: the worn, faded hem is kept and re-attached higher up, so your jeans look untouched.
- **Trouser hems, plain or blind stitch**: an invisible finish for work trousers and smart trousers.
- **Lined trouser hems and turn-ups**: lining and outer shortened separately so they hang properly.
- **Take in the waist or taper the legs**: for standard trousers and for jeans, including heavier denim.

### Getting the length right

We are happy to pin your hems at drop-off. Bring the shoes you will wear with them, because a trainer and a heeled boot need very different lengths. If it is easier, pin or measure your preferred length at home and we will work to that. Please bring trousers and jeans freshly washed: we only work on clean items, and pre-washed denim will not shrink after we have hemmed it.

### How long does it take?

Standard turnaround is 3–5 days. Need them for a wedding, an interview or a trip? Express turnaround is 24–48 hours for an extra £5.

Looking for something else? See [jeans zip replacement](https://newquayseamstress.com/zip-replacement-newquay/) or [pocket and seam repairs](https://newquayseamstress.com/clothing-repairs-newquay/).

### Guide prices for this service

**Guide prices only.** Every garment is different, so your final price is confirmed at drop-off or consultation, depending on the garment and the work needed. Nothing is started until you have agreed the price.

## Zip Replacement & Buttons in Newquay

> Zip replacement in Newquay: trouser & skirt zips guide £15, jeans £18, coats from £25. Buttons from £3. Guide prices, confirmed at drop-off.

Source: https://newquayseamstress.com/zip-replacement-newquay/

Zips · buttons · buttonholes

Trouser, skirt, jeans, coat and jacket zips replaced, buttons restitched and new machine buttonholes. Guide prices from £3.

[Call 07807 274898](tel:+447807274898)[Guide prices](https://newquayseamstress.com/prices/)

### Broken zip? Do not throw it away

A broken zip is the most common reason a favourite coat or pair of jeans ends up at the back of the wardrobe, and it is one of the most satisfying repairs we do. A zip that is set in properly, with straight stitching and the teeth hidden where they should be, makes a garment feel new again.

### Zip replacement we offer

- **Trouser and skirt zips**: guide price includes a standard zip.
- **Jeans zips**: guide price includes a heavy-duty metal zip, because jeans need one.
- **Coat and jacket zips**: from the guide price plus the cost of the specialist zip (open-ended, two-way and chunky outdoor zips vary in length and type).
- **Cushion cover zips**: see [curtains & home](https://newquayseamstress.com/curtain-alterations-newquay/).

### Buttons and buttonholes

Lost a button or have one hanging by a thread? Button replacement or restitching is a guide £3 each, or 3 for £7. We can also add a **new machine buttonhole**, which is handy when a button has been moved after taking a waistband in.

### Before you drop off

Please wash the garment first, as we only work on clean items. If you have a particular zip colour or the original spare button, bring it along. Standard turnaround is 3–5 days, or 24–48 hours express for an extra £5.

Related: [jeans hems and tapering](https://newquayseamstress.com/trouser-jeans-alterations-newquay/) · [clothing repairs](https://newquayseamstress.com/clothing-repairs-newquay/)

## Clothing Repairs & Mending in Newquay

> Clothing repairs in Newquay: split seams, small tears, patches and pocket bags mended by an ex-military tailor. Guide prices from £8, confirmed at drop-off.

Source: https://newquayseamstress.com/clothing-repairs-newquay/

Seams · tears · patches · pockets

Split seams restitched, small tears and patches repaired, pocket bags rebuilt and buttons sewn back on. Guide prices from £8.

[Call 07807 274898](tel:+447807274898)[Guide prices](https://newquayseamstress.com/prices/)

### Mending that makes clothes last

The most sustainable garment is the one already in your wardrobe. A split seam, a small tear or a hole in a pocket lining is usually a quick fix, and a neat repair can add years to a jacket, a pair of work trousers or a much-loved jumper. Newquay is hard on clothes, from salt, sand and wetsuit-changing in car parks, and we see plenty of it.

![Vintage black sewing machine with gold decals, coloured thread spools and tweed fabric swatches](https://newquayseamstress.com/assets/img/vintage-sewing-machine-newquay-seamstress-1024.webp)

### Repairs we carry out

- **Split seam restitching**: side seams, seat seams, underarms and crotch seams re-sewn and reinforced.
- **Small tear and patch repairs**: neat repairs or patches on everyday clothes and workwear.
- **Pocket bag repair or replacement**: worn-through trouser and coat pockets rebuilt so you stop losing your keys.
- **Buttons**: replaced or restitched, guide £3 each or 3 for £7.

Our minimum repair charge is £8. If you are not sure whether something can be saved, bring it in. We would rather tell you honestly at drop-off than charge for a repair that will not last.

### Clean items, please

Garments must be freshly washed before drop-off. Standard turnaround is 3–5 days, with express 24–48 hours for an extra £5.

See also: [zip replacement](https://newquayseamstress.com/zip-replacement-newquay/) · [trouser alterations](https://newquayseamstress.com/trouser-jeans-alterations-newquay/)

## Curtain Shortening & Alterations in Newquay

> Curtains shortened in Newquay: unlined from £20 a pair, lined & blackout from £32 (guide prices). Cushion zips replaced, guide £12. Ideal for holiday lets.

Source: https://newquayseamstress.com/curtain-alterations-newquay/

Curtains · cushions · home

Unlined, lined and blackout curtains shortened per pair, and cushion cover zips replaced. Guide prices from £12.

[Call 07807 274898](tel:+447807274898)[Guide prices](https://newquayseamstress.com/prices/)

### Curtains shortened to fit, without buying new

New windows, a move, or a bargain pair that is just a little too long: shortening curtains is far cheaper than replacing them, and done properly nobody can tell. We shorten unlined curtains and lined or blackout curtains, keeping hems straight, linings hanging correctly and weights in place.

![Teal velvet and cream linen curtains pinned for a new hem on a wooden table, with tape measure, shears and a floral cushion](https://newquayseamstress.com/assets/img/curtain-shortening-newquay-1024.webp)

### Curtain and home services

- **Shorten unlined curtains**: per pair, guide price from £20.
- **Shorten lined or blackout curtains**: per pair, guide price from £32. Lining and face fabric are shortened separately.
- **Cushion cover zip replacement**: guide £12, great for sofa cushions and holiday-let soft furnishings.

### Measuring your curtains

Measure from the top of the curtain (or the hook position) to where you want the hem to finish, and note whether you want them to just clear the floor, sit on the sill or puddle. Please bring curtains freshly washed: we can only work on clean items, and washing first avoids shrinkage after shortening.

### For holiday lets and second homes

Newquay, Crantock and Padstow are full of holiday lets with tired soft furnishings. Shortening curtains and replacing broken cushion zips between seasons is an easy way to freshen a property. Standard turnaround is 3–5 days, or express 24–48 hours for an extra £5.

### Guide prices for this service

## A Military Tailor & Her Daughter

> Meet Sylvia Tippett, a tailor at RAF St Mawgan for over 50 years, and her daughter Maxine Jennings: Newquay's mother-and-daughter seamstresses.

Source: https://newquayseamstress.com/about/

Our story

A military tailor with more than 50 years at the cutting table, and the daughter learning every stitch from her.

### Fifty years of tailoring at RAF St Mawgan

Sylvia Pauline Tippett was a tailor at RAF St Mawgan, near Newquay, working for the military for over 50 years. Military tailoring is unforgiving: uniforms are worn on parade, inspected closely and expected to last. Hems must be level, seams straight and every detail regulation-correct. Half a century of that work builds a level of precision you can see in the finish.

Sylvia's skill reaches well beyond uniforms: over her career she has made ball gowns, suits and wedding dresses, and that understanding of how garments are constructed is what lets her alter them so well, from a simple pair of jeans to a layered bridal gown.

### Mother and daughter

Maxine Jennings is Sylvia's daughter. For more than three years she has worked alongside her mum, learning her skills and standards at the sewing machine, so the craft continues in Newquay for the next generation of customers.

![Vintage tailoring workshop with a green wool uniform-style jacket on a dress form and an old cast-iron sewing machine](https://newquayseamstress.com/assets/img/military-tailor-workshop-raf-st-mawgan-1024.webp)Precision, stitch by stitch

Meet the makers

### Sylvia & Maxine

50+years

### Sylvia Pauline Tippett

Tailor & founder

Sylvia has more than 50 years' experience as a tailor. She was a tailor at RAF St Mawgan, working for the military for over 50 years, where uniforms had to be precise, hard-wearing and immaculately finished, every single time.

3+years

### Maxine Jennings

Seamstress

Maxine is Sylvia's daughter. She has more than three years' experience working alongside her mum, learning the tailoring skills and standards Sylvia built over half a century.

### What that means for you

- ### Precision

  Military-standard finishing on everyday alterations.

## Frequently Asked Questions

> Answers on alteration guide prices, 3–5 day turnaround, 24–48 hour express, washing, pinning hems, zips and curtain shortening in Newquay.

Source: https://newquayseamstress.com/faq/

FAQ

Prices, turnaround, washing, pinning and how to book. Everything people ask before bringing work in.

How much do alterations cost in Newquay?

Our [guide prices](https://newquayseamstress.com/prices/) start from £3 for a button and £10 for a standard jeans hem. Trouser hems are a guide £12, zip replacements from £15 and curtain shortening from £20 per pair. These are guide prices only: the final price is confirmed at drop-off or consultation, depending on the garment and the work needed.

How long do alterations take?

Standard turnaround is 3–5 days. If you need it sooner, our express service turns most jobs around in 24–48 hours for an extra £5.

Do my clothes or curtains need to be washed first?

Yes please. We can only work on clean items, so garments and curtains must be freshly washed before drop-off. It keeps the workroom (and everyone else's clothes) clean and means hems are measured on fabric that has already shrunk.

Can you pin my hem when I drop off?

Yes. We are happy to pin hems at drop-off, so bring the shoes you will wear with trousers or a dress. Alternatively you can pin or measure your preferred length at home and we will work to that.

Can you shorten jeans and keep the original hem?

Yes. A jeans hem keeping the original factory hem (so the worn, faded edge stays) has a guide price of £15. A standard jeans hem is a guide £10.

Do zip replacements include the zip?

Trouser and skirt zip replacement (guide £15) includes a standard zip, and jeans zip replacement (guide £18) includes a heavy-duty metal zip. Coat and jacket zips start from £25 plus the cost of the specialist zip, as these vary in length and type.

Is there a minimum charge?

Yes, the minimum repair charge is £8. Buttons are the exception: replacing or restitching a button is a guide £3, or 3 for £7.

Do you shorten curtains, including lined and blackout curtains?

Yes. Shortening unlined curtains starts from £20 per pair and lined or blackout curtains from £32 per pair. We also replace cushion cover zips (guide £12).

Who will be working on my clothes?

Sylvia Pauline Tippett, a tailor with more than 50 years' experience who spent her career as a tailor at RAF St Mawgan, and her daughter Maxine Jennings, who has worked alongside her for over three years. [Meet them](https://newquayseamstress.com/about/).

Where are you and which areas do you cover?

We are based in Newquay, Cornwall, and drop-off is by arrangement, so call or message Maxine on [07807 274898](tel:+447807274898). Customers bring work to us from across Cornwall, including St Columb, Crantock, St Newlyn East, Perranporth, St Austell and Truro. [See all areas](https://newquayseamstress.com/areas-we-serve/).

How do I book?

Call or message Maxine on [07807 274898](tel:+447807274898), email [maxinejennings58@gmail.com](mailto:maxinejennings58@gmail.com) or use the [contact form](https://newquayseamstress.com/contact/) to arrange a drop-off.
